items.title: Dell Just Jumped 16% and One Strategist Says That Is the Whole Tech Argument Right Now
items.summary: Dell's 16% single-day surge gave one market strategist the proof he needed that AI spending is grounded in fundamentals, not hype. But a closer look at the margins hiding beneath that record backlog tells a more complicated story about who actually profits when customers buy AI servers.

items.title: Dell Stock Is Surging on Its $95 Billion AI Backlog. Could DELL Hit $600 Next?
items.summary: Dell just posted numbers that have analysts scrambling to reset their models, and a single metric buried in the earnings release explains why the stock could still have room to run despite already tripling this year.

items.title: Hewlett Packard Enterprise Falls 5% as Supply Constraints Overshadow Raised Guidance, Super Micro Slips, Dell Holds Steady
items.summary: HPE just raised its guidance and posted blockbuster growth, yet the stock is sinking while the broader tech market climbs. The reason why has less to do with demand and more to do with a supply problem that could haunt the company for quarters to come.

items.title: Why Super Micro Computer Stock Took Off in August
items.summary: Super Micro delivered improved margins, forecast huge growth for the year ahead, and shored up some corporate governance concerns.

items.title: 1 Value Stock with Exciting Potential and 2 We Find Risky
items.summary: Value stocks typically trade at discounts to the broader market, offering patient investors the opportunity to buy businesses when they’re out of favor. The key risk, however, is that these stocks are usually cheap for a reason, and a low valuation can reflect underlying business challenges rather than a genuine bargain.
